subject: math

hotspots.label: Ratio
hotspots.description: The ratio label showing red : blue = 3 : 5 — the comparison of the two bead groups.
hotspots.positionHint: The floating label plate above the two bead groups.
hotspots.function: Shows the comparison of two quantities.

hotspots.label: Compared groups
hotspots.description: Each bead group is one side of the ratio — 3 red beads and 5 blue beads.
hotspots.positionHint: The group of red beads and the group of blue beads on the tray.

hotspots.label: Part to whole
hotspots.description: In part-to-whole mode, the ratio reads red : total = 3 : 8.
hotspots.positionHint: The total-count label shown when the view is toggled.
hotspots.function: Shows a part compared against the entire group.

visualStyleNotes: Fractions And Ratios, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. Two calm bead groups on a tray with a ratio label above and a scale control. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / coral / molecular-green from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Red beads: small warm coral spheres (roughness ~0.4). Blue beads: small soft grid-blue-grey spheres (roughness ~0.4). Tray: soft warm-grey dish (roughness ~0.7). Ratio label: warm paper plate with ink text. Scale control: soft grey rail with amber knob. No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: a ratio as two bead groups — 3 red beads vs 5 blue beads — with a scaling control that doubles both groups while the ratio stays 3:5, plus a part-of-whole toggle.

GEOMETRY: Tray: shallow rounded dish (~3 wide). Left: 3 red beads in a row at x ≈ −0.7. Right: 5 blue beads in a row at x ≈ 0.7. Ratio label: floating plate at y ≈ 0.65 reading 'red : blue = 3 : 5'. A Scale control (×1, ×2, ×3) clones both groups proportionally. A View toggle switches between part-to-part ('red : blue = 6 : 10') and part-to-whole ('red : total = 6 : 16').

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) bead groups; (2) ratio label; (3) total/scale overlays.

CAMERA: head-on, slightly above, from +z frames both groups and label; calm. Budget 6-10k triangles. Named nodes: Tray, RedBeads, BlueBeads, RatioLabel, ScaleControl, ViewToggle, TotalLabel. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
